The next bounded production batch restores the existing native answer Links Notation contract, not a replacement evidence format. Source remains held until the coordinator announces the integration push.

Scratch reviewed mechanism T2472 plus seven contracts T2473 initially exposed a newly authored escaping expectation mismatch at T2474; T2475 corrected that synthetic expectation and additionally pinned raw native serialized bytes. Exact same test command T2476 passes seven contracts. No native compile or native runtime was invoked.

Current production mismatch: symbolicFromWorker assigns the worker meta-reasoner derivation to links_notation. Actual Hi therefore has parsed root derivation, whereas unchanged links_network.rs::every_answer_includes_links_notation_trace requires answer_*. Keep the full worker result derivation intact as provenance. Build a separate answer record from actual ordered solverEvents, including declared prior-turn events. Preserve exact six fields and order: prompt, intent, answer, trace, steps, thinking_steps. Native answer ID is answer_<stable_id("prompt", prompt)>; trace is the content-addressed actual trace event ID at its real append position. Use the existing shared formatLinoRecord and flattenLinoValue. Record thinking uses thinkingStepsFromEvents(events) with no final answer; display thinking retains its existing final-answer argument.

Use a small authored helper with explicit prompt, intent, answer, event log, and trace ID inputs, visibly cited to engine.rs::answer_links_notation. The server wrapper selects the actual impulse and actual trace event from a shared EventLog. A log absent in synthetic caller data must not fabricate observations. Native finalize_answer subsequently appends its independent persisted derivation record; preserve that operation and its order. Existing node-host.mjs solve wrapper drops history before symbolic recasting: pass the actual supplied history through, preserving event indices and trace IDs.

The source-qualified definition handler currently has genuine capture evidence but no typed capture solverEvents. Introduce an outcome-to-event projection at the successful observed capture boundary, matching native order: term; source:http capture payload; optional cache_hit; source registry ID; source URL; kind; captured status. Unresolved paths emit only actual term and observed status. Set the native response link response:source-qualified-definition. Preserve handler evidence compatibility and raw worker derivation. Do not infer source events from evidence strings, join links, or create missing source markers. A short separate worker event helper and exact source-derived budget avoid raising the existing 107-line source-qualified module ceiling.

Acceptance checks: retain original native greeting notation assertions unchanged, execute actual native-equivalent JavaScript server surface; exact arbitrary six-field record bytes; real calculator cluster numbering and response-only record thinking; genuine prior-turn role/order/trace indexing; original citation plus held-out standard definition and unknown provider, requiring actual observed capture SHA/time/URL in ordered events; proper quote doubling, Unicode, control sanitization and raw serialized bytes; absent event rejection in the pure contract. Update native integration fixtures only by adding meaningful contract assertions. Run closest original solver trace, derivation persistence, citation, actual protocol, and specification checks. Standalone rustfmt only; native checks remain CI.

Typed reader expansion is a later finite batch. T2470 actual inventory parsed 179 of 1,171 cases, 24 default-ready and 155 explicitly blocked on runtime identity.
